author: BusyEquinox

commands.title: Set Brightness to 0%
commands.description: Set the brightness of your Mac to 0%.

commands.description: Set the brightness of your Mac to 25%.

commands.name: set-brightness-to-50
commands.title: Set Brightness to 50%
commands.description: Set the brightness of your Mac to 50%.

commands.name: set-brightness-to-75
commands.title: Set Brightness to 75%
commands.description: Set the brightness of your Mac to 75%.

commands.name: set-brightness-to-100

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
